title: WebStoreInventorySource - Data API
description: Used to configure the inventory source for a webstore. This object is available in API version 57.0 and later.

DoesAllowGuestInventoryLevel.description: Indicates whether guest users can view a product’s inventory levels when guest checkout is disabled.

InventoryCacheTtl.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
InventoryCacheTtl.description: Amount of time in seconds before cache expires.

InventoryDimension.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
InventoryDimension.description: Specifies which field within inventory levels to use to determine availability. Possible values are AvailableToFulfill,AvailableToOrder,OnHand.

IsBopisEnabled.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsBopisEnabled.description: Indicates whether the location supports buy online, pick up in store. The default value is false.

IsChkInvOnActiveCartEnabled.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsChkInvOnActiveCartEnabled.description: Indicates whether the inventory is checked when a customer adds or edits an item in the active cart. If an admin wants to enable the inventory check feature for their store, they must set this value to true. The default value is true.

IsDefault.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsDefault.description: Indicates whether this is the default inventory source value (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

IsEnabled.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsEnabled.description: Indicates whether the default inventory source is active. The default value is false.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, this record might only have been referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

LocationSourceExtRef.description: The external reference identifier associated with the LocationSourceId.

LocationSourceId.description: The location ID or location group ID for this webstore. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The source name for this entity.

ReservationDurationInSeconds.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ReservationDurationInSeconds.description: The amount of time in seconds that a reservation stays active and doesn’t expire. Required for implementations using Omnichannel Inventory.

ShowGuestInventoryLevel.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
ShowGuestInventoryLevel.description: Displays the inventory level to guest users, even when guest checkout is disabled. The default value is false. This field is available in API version 65.0 and later.

WebStoreId.description: The unique store ID related to this inventory source. This field is a relationship field.

DoesAllowGuestInventoryLevel.field_label: Allows guest user access to inventory level.

IsChkInvOnActiveCartEnabled.field_label: Check Inventory on Products For an Active Cart.
